messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=inference-queue-priority, severity=high. Incident INC-4251. Symptoms: embeddings queue spike, 5xx rate ~12% in us-east-1. Auto-paging to on-call.

oncall_emma: Acked. I'm on it :hand: digging in now.

sre_alan: Can you paste the Grafana link and any quick logs? I'll check dedicated pools and kvcache.

oncall_emma: here: https://grafana.redwood/inference/graphs/INC-4251
Queue length ~340, 95th latency 2.4s, errors show originate from embedder-01 (embedder service).

dmitri: @oncall_emma is customer-facing traffic impacted or just background batch? Any headroom in Dedicated capacity?

oncall_emma: Quick look: top 10 customers show ~10% latency uplift, a handful of requests returned 503. Not global yet. We added reserved nodes last night so there's some headroom.

ops_robin: Increasing dedicated pool by +2 nodes (hot-add). I'll watch autoscaler events and kube readiness.

sre_alan: Plan: scale first, then graceful restart of embedder-01 to clear stuck workers. I'll avoid a hard kill to preserve cache.
Command to run when nodes are ready:
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embedder-01\```

oncall_emma: Scaling finished, +2 nodes online, pods are ready per events. Proceed with restart when you want.

sre_alan: Restart started. If 5xx doesn't fall within 2m, we'll rollback and route traffic to embedder-02 (lower perf) as an emergency fallback to keep latencies bounded.

laura_support: Looping in CSMs. Laura will prepare a short customer blurb for affected tenants.

laura_support: Draft message: "We're investigating elevated errors and latency for embeddings. Engineering is actively mitigating; we'll provide an update in 15 minutes."

oncall_emma: 5xx dropped to ~1.5%, queues are draining. Keeping watch for 10 minutes. Handing ownership to @sre_alan for post-incident timeline and followups.

sre_alan: Taking ownership for the followup and postmortem. Will capture timeline and logs. If everything stays stable we'll close the PD escalation.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-4251 acknowledged by oncall_emma. Will escalate to tier2 automatically if no updates in 15m.

ops_robin: :thumbsup: I've got autoscaler logs streaming. Tell me if we need rapid rollback or to throttle background jobs.

sre_alan: Update: steady-state observed, 5xx < 0.5%, latency back to baseline. Mitigation successful. Keeping monitoring window for 30m, collecting logs for RCA.

oncall_emma: Thanks all. I'll add mitigation notes to the PD incident and post the customer message. Closing this thread if no regressions in the watch window.
